column1: # Manual coding of included papers (input to build_tables.py). Codes are defined in build_tables.py; basis: A=title+abstract, O=outline d0008 (authors read full text), X=tvly extract of full text, T=title only.

column10: note
Multi-provider decentralized retrieval with bounded leakage (OpenReview snippet only).
Magazine-style deployment framework for RAG at the 6G edge.
Committee-certified documents kept across chains; integrity, not partitioned retrieval accuracy.
MPC over secret-shared database across servers; leakage guaranteed by protocol, not measured empirically.
C-FedRAG: MedRAG corpora on 2 simulated sites; MIRAGE accuracy vs pooled 4-corpus RAG; no time/cost.
Blockchain/DHT multi-source RAG; evaluation framework on scalability/efficiency.
EACO-RAG: matches accuracy of cloud KG-RAG; cost and delay measured.
FeB4RAG: 16 BEIR sub-collections as search engines; dataset paper, side-by-side generation comparison.
FL-trained medical LLM + RAG vs non-RAG.
FRAG: encrypted ANN across distrusted parties; efficiency close to centralized (not accuracy).
MediRAG: MIMIC-IV split over simulated hospitals; 'no loss vs centralized' on ROUGE/BLEU and LLM-judged RAG metrics.
Legal federated search + RAG case study / position.
SocialGenPod: personal Solid pods (owner-held data); prototype demo, no quantitative evaluation in abstract.
dRAG: 6 simulated sources with varied reliability; +10.7% over centralized counterpart (metric unspecified in abstract); cost of blockchain updates.
Country-LLM hierarchy with DRAG routing and incentives; framework only.
Edge cache of cloud KB with DRL replacement; cache hit and latency.
AgentNet: 'centralized' = centralized multi-agent coordination, not pooled data.
Hecking et al.: architecture and External Retrieval Interface protocol.
ChainShare: provider-owned documents, compared with LLM without RAG plus user survey.
CoEdge-RAG: heterogeneous data across edge nodes; gains over scheduling baselines.
CoSense-LLM: home/office/clinic deployments; sensor streams + local notes; no centralized-data comparison.
D-RAG: subject communities with permissioned chains; scalability of consensus.
SHIMI: agents keep local memory trees and sync; retrieval accuracy vs flat vector retrieval.
DF-RAG: federated fine-tuning + federated KGs; 'initial evaluations' only.
DGRAG: UltraDomain fields per edge; LLM win rate vs Cent. RAG (v2 adds recall); bandwidth fixed at 50 Mbps, number of physical edges not stated.
DRAG: BA-network simulation of 20-100 peers; near-centralized performance with about half the messages (partition unverified).
DP-CR: FeB4RAG corpora; DP centroids; MIA AUC and latency vs LLM router.
DRAGON: cloud server + MacBook over Wi-Fi; public cloud DB + device personal docs; gain over standalone SLM compared with centralized RAG.
RAGRoute: MIRAGE/MMLU corpora as sources; queries and accuracy vs querying all sources.
BTE-RAG: federation of public biomedical APIs; vs LLM-only.
FL-trained adapter retriever for edge devices; FL speedup.
Multi-product federated RAG (one source per product, Adobe).
FeRAG for IoE log analysis vs other LLM log-analysis methods.
FedRAG++: domain-specific clients; vs RAG baselines.
FedRAG framework (fine-tuning RAG across centralized/federated architectures); tooling paper.
Title only (no abstract available via S2).
HyFedRAG: PMC-Patients across clients; edge-cloud; caching for latency.
pFedRAG: federated tuning of embedding models.
Inter-organizational meta-agent chatbot with privacy-focused RAG.
EPEAgent: privacy within federated multi-agent RAG; privacy protection evaluated.
FedE4RAG: federated embedding learning with HE.
Title only (no abstract available via S2).
Federated clinical QA: each hospital node holds a different public ICU dataset; feasibility demo.
RIRS: per-agent local corpora with embedding summaries for routing.
Routing hijacking attack on FedRAG routing (integrity attack, not leakage measurement).
Turkish federated RAG architecture; mathematical framework.
Scrambled distributed attention; utility vs plaintext (<0.1% drop), inversion-attack defense, latency.
ARTI: department-level RAG across government silos; controlled simulations (drafting time).
FedRepRAG: Dirichlet split over 10 clients on one A100; below IC-RAG in some settings; residual representation leakage analysed.
Byzantine-robust federated conformal RAG (owner nodes score answers).
Campus Assistant: per-school indexes of institutional documents (organizational owners, public documents); usage report.
Monitoring of federated conformal RAG.
CONCORD: device private docs + cloud public; quality comparable to dense dual-end aggregation; throughput and communication.
Distributed enterprise RAG: partitioned enterprise-style corpora; nDCG@10 within 1.3 pt of centralized; latency by node placement.
DyRRS: emulation with real network traces.
EC-RAG: edge SLM vs cloud LLM routing; F1 vs LLM-only RAG (centralized model, not centralized data).
Edge-cloud semantic caching; latency and backhaul traffic.
Edge-RAG over Bluetooth mesh on mobile devices; abstract/full text not retrievable.
EduBot: 3 textbook domains; token F1 vs centralized (centralized training, not pooled retrieval).
RAGSpot (Sci. Rep.); only title and one-line snippet retrieved.
Inferential composition control for federated RAG in data spaces; case study.
SQuAD v1.1 over 5 non-IID clients; centralized vs federated with matched candidate budget and the same BM25+FAISS+RRF pipeline.
FD-RAG: 5 disjoint clients; Jetson Orin Nano latency on one device; LDP reconstruction attack.
Fed-S2: per-domain fault datasets; vs traditional FL; inversion risk bound; communication.
TON_IoT over 10 non-IID clients; MIA AUC 0.51.
Federated GraphRAG with routing and controlled-disclosure evidence.
FC-RAG under bandwidth budgets (bits per message).
FedTempRAG: simulated multi-hospital RPM network; latency and computation overhead.
FedMosaic: parametric adapters instead of raw text.
FedRAG-FT: BEIR domain-partitioned clients; vs federated baselines.
Title only (no abstract available via S2).
DEFRAG: heterogeneous edge testbed; benchmark QA with balanced/non-uniform placement; accuracy vs centralized SLM/LLM, cost and throughput vs centralized services.
GEHMAR: edge local RAG, cloud gets desensitized evidence; raw-data transmission volume.
GRaSP: 5-node CloudLab with emulated 4-region WAN; NQ uniform/topical placement; EM within 0.062 of relevance-only ranking.
MEC RAG with poisoning-aware retrieval depth/power control; energy.
Synthetic farming-vehicle KG on blockchain; task success vs centralized approaches.
Edge-cloud vector cache coherency; vs cloud-only.
CARD: within 4.4 pt of centralized upper bound (metric unspecified); communication cost.
DP retrieval with federated edge layer; utility at epsilon=1.
Private selective-risk certificates for federated RAG.
RealRoute: retrieve-then-verify across heterogeneous sources.
SAFER-Bench: 1-4 Data Owners over medical corpora; accuracy vs fewer owners.
SCOUT-RAG: comparable to centralized baselines (DRIFT, exhaustive traversal); calls, tokens, latency.
SRAG: domain-specialized KB per edge server.
Flower-based federated RAG with confidential computing.
Trans-RAG: per-organization vector spaces; nDCG drop vs plaintext; isolation rates.
